caption:
Healthier Chicken Ghee Roast, Simplified 
high protein | meal prep friendly | low carb 

Nutrition: 
C: 14 | F: 13 | P: 50
Calories: 375 per serve
Makes 3 portions 

Ingredients
450 grams chicken breast, cubed 
marinade: 
1 tsp haldi 
1 - 2  tbsp thick dahi / greek yogurt
1 tsp red chilli powder
2 sprigs curry leaves 
salt to taste

paste
1 tbsp coriander seeds
10 black peppercorns
1 tsp cumin seeds
1/2 tsp methi seeds
8 kashmiri chilli
6 byadgiri chillies
10 garlic cloves
1 inch ginger
1 tbsp tamarind paste or small tamarind ball soaked in 2 tbsp water

1 tbsp ghee
salt to taste
1 tsp sugar
3-4 sprigs curry leaves

Method 
marinate the chicken for a minimum of 30 minutes
( i do mine in the morning and cook it in the evening so gives it a good time for marination ) 

dry roast all the masalas together and allow to cool
blitz with the ginger and tamarind paste, set aside

in a pan, add in the ghee, let it heat then add in the paste we just made and cook for 10-15 minutes on a low flame, it will thicken and change colour ( you have to remember usually you will see the fat leaving the paste as it thickens but since we have used the bare minimum this doesnt happen, you want the raw smell and taste to go away primarily ) 
add in salt, sugar and curry leaves and stir together and cook for a few more minutes
add in the coooked chicken and combine well 
you can add a splash of water too for consistency 

serve with roti, dosai, steamed rice or as is :) 

Please note this recipe is on the spicier side and you can reduce the dry chillies by 2 per type and add an additional tbsp of yogurt for the chicken marinade
